title: Vateereri Vakavanzika Vakatenda
intro: Murunyararo rwemusangano mutsvene, gungano rinoshamisa rakasvika richibva kunyika isingaonekwe. Vachikwezvwa nekuzevezera kwechimwe chinhu chinoshamisa, vakateerera kudzokororwa kwaizosimbisa mugumo wavo nekusingaperi. Uchapupu hwavo hunoramba huri humwe hwehunhu hwakasiyana mumagwaro matsvene.
clues: Tiri zvisikwa zvinobva munzvimbo isingaonekwi nevakawanda, uye takauya seboka.
Takaenda kumusangano kuti tinzwe chimwe chinhu chinoshamisa.
Patakasvika, takateerera kuverengwa kwenyaya yacho kwakatishamisa.
Takabvuma pachena kuti vamwe vedu vakarurama uye vamwe havasi.
Taiziva kuti hatingagoni kutiza murairo waMwari panyika, kana kutizira mudenga.
Patakanzwa gwara, takaritenda; ani naani anotenda munaShe wake haazotyi kurasikirwa kana mutoro.
arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verse: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways. (72:11)
